back: Regulated market for buying and selling securities of listed organisations and government.
Market for second-hand securities; raises capital for companies and government; values securities; protects investors; channels savings.
Agent who buys and sells securities for clients for commission (brokerage) and gives advice.
Dealer who holds shares and quotes bid and offer prices; earns the turn (spread).
Speculator who buys expecting prices to rise.
Speculator who sells expecting prices to fall, hoping to buy back cheaper.
Speculator who buys new issues expecting to sell quickly at a higher price.
Capital for companies, liquidity and returns for investors, savings mobilised for growth, government borrowing, economic indicator.
